item.title: Ethiopia: Who could bring the warring sides to the negotiation table?
item.description: Ethiopia might be facing its most complex armed conflict in contempary times. The fragile 2022 peace deal has collapsed. International mediators have failed. How will the country manage to return to normal?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Renee Good's family sues Trump admin over fatal ICE shooting
item.description: The family of Renee Good, one of two US citizens fatally shot by federal immigration agents in Minneapolis in January, has sued President Donald Trump's administration alleging negligence and civil rights violations.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: North and South Korea trade accusations over landmines that injured three soldiers
item.description: A mine blast that injured three South Korean soldiers has renewed scrutiny of North Korea's actions along the border and raised questions about its strategic goals.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Zimbabwe tycoon Wicknell Chivayo dies in helicopter crash
item.description: Zimbabwe's President Emmerson Mnangagwa has confirmed the death of businessman Wicknell Chivayo and his wife in a helicopter crash, calling the high-rollers with a lavish lifestyle "consummately philanthropic."
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: A brutal assault reignites fears over women's safety in India
item.description: A string of sexual assault cases has revived questions about women's safety in India, fuelling fear, protests and demands for action.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: UAE launches Flydubai hijacking and terrorism investigation
item.description: The UAE's chief prosecutor said it's looking at the possibility of "terrorist activity or intent" in the alleged attempted hijacking of a Flydubai commercial flight to Tel Aviv. It says it has jurisdiction in the case.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: France: Hundreds arrested as student protests escalate
item.description: Student protests have grown in scale and intensity, with violent clashes in some places leading to hundreds of arrests and dozens of injuries.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Gaza: NGO reports dire camp conditions, says Israel is moving 'Yellow Line'
item.description: The Danish Refugee Council alleges that Israel is employing "a policy of protracted displacement" in Gaza. It says the so-called "Yellow Line" is creeping west toward the coast, preventing many from returning home.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Five EU states plan first deportation center in Africa for 2027
item.description: Greece, Germany, Austria, Denmark and the Netherlands are moving forward with plans to establish deportation centers for rejected asylum seekers outside the EU.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Are the Houthis winning against Saudi Arabia?
item.description: It's unclear how the Saudis can defuse the threat presented by the Houthis in next-door Yemen or who they can turn to for help. The US isn't interested, the Europeans are hedging and nobody wants open conflict with Iran.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Iran's nuclear program remains shrouded in mystery as the regime debates ditching non-proliferation
item.description: Iran's nuclear program is entering a critical phase as Tehran debates dropping out of a nuclear non-proliferation treaty. Satellite images also show activity at known nuclear sites.
